- ring kg is cols times rings times ring len times the pow of 8 divided by 162.

describe:
Spend or Save, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- flow: dir: one of Spend, Save, starts at Spend; amount: money; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- sp is the total amount of flow in the week of d where dir is Spend.
- sv is the total amount of flow in the week of d where dir is Save.
Remembers while you use it: d, starting at today.
Shows:
- a bar with "Spend or Save" and a button that opens a form to add a flow.
- a button "<"; a tap sets d to d minus 7.
- text: "Week of", d.
- a button ">"; a tap sets d to d plus 7.
- text: sp.
- text: "spent".
- text: s
needs: spent and saved totals for the week

describe:
Curtain Quote, in the grey colours.
Keeps:
- quote: customer: text; width: number, 1 to 40; drop: number, 1 to 20; total: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Fabric per yard": money, starts at 450; "Stitching charge": money, starts at 600; "Fullness (2 = double width)": number, starts at 2.
Works out:
- panels is w times fullness divided by 4 rounded down plus 1.
- yards is panels times the result of h plus 0.5 divided by 3 times 10 rounded divided by 10.
- cost is yards times rate plus stitch.
Remembers while you use it: who, starting at ""; w, starting at 5; h,
needs: set window width and height with sliders
total price from fabric rate and stitching
fabric rate and stitching charge settings
save the quote with the customer name

- a choice of sex.
- a box to fill in waist, labelled "Waist (cm)".
- a box to fill in hip, labelled "Hip (cm)".
- a card with a big number r times 100 rounded divided by 100, labelled "Enter both measures" when r is 0, otherwise "Low risk" when r is less than limit, otherwise "Moderate risk" when r is less than limit plus 0.1, otherwis
